name: sigflint
description: Fast, dependency-free AWS Signature Version 4 signing for every AWS service: headers, presigned URLs, SigV4a, chunked uploads and event streams. Node.js, Bun, Deno, Cloudflare Workers and browsers.
author: bompus

scripts.build: bun build src/node.js --target=node --outfile=dist/node.js && bun build src/bun.js --target=bun --outfile=dist/bun.js
scripts.types: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && D="$PWD" && cd / && bun check -p "$D/tsconfig.json" && bun check -p "$D/test/types"
scripts.format: oxfmt . && ruff format . && git ls-files -z '*.sh' | xargs -0 shfmt -w
scripts.check:style: oxfmt --check . && npm run lint && npm run check:py && npm run check:sh
scripts.check: npm run check:style && npm run types && npm run types:streams && npm run types:bench && npm test && npm run check:package
scripts.check:sh: git ls-files -z '*.sh' | xargs -0 shellcheck && git ls-files -z '*.sh' | xargs -0 shfmt -d -i 2 -bn -ci
scripts.check:package: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && npm run build && publint && attw --pack . --profile esm-only
